description: The camera stands on the Natisone bank in Cividale del Friuli, looking at the Ponte del Diavolo in the late afternoon. Two unequal limestone arches meet on a central pier founded on a rock in the riverbed: the left arch is wider and lower, the right arch narrower and taller, and the roadway rises to a peak above that pier. It is a paired-arch bridge, not a single high span. Stone houses and trees line the gorge.
